### Discovery & Translational Science

*   **Ribosomal RNA fragment identified in pulmonary hypertension** [doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.09.765510]
    *   Researchers identified 28S rsRNA-CTC_L20, which is upregulated in hypoxic pulmonary artery smooth muscle cells (PASMCs). 
    *   The molecule drives proliferation by stabilizing mRNA for ketogenic enzymes, increasing BHB, and enhancing PKM2 β-hydroxybutyrylation.
*   **Bacterial arginine deiminase pathway extends *C. elegans* lifespan** [doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.07.749978]
    *   *Lactococcus lactis* JCM 5805 extends *C. elegans* maximum lifespan by exploiting the bacterial arginine deiminase pathway, leading to L-citrulline and L-ornithine accumulation and upregulation of cuticle-formation genes.
*   **Genetic variants linked to drug response found in *All of Us* study** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/12/all-of-us-study-finds-gene-variants-drug-responses/)
    *   A study of nearly 100,000 diverse participants identified thousands of new genetic variants influencing pharmacological responses.
*   **Proteomics reveal diabetic kidney disease signatures** [doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.10.26367534]
    *   Longitudinal profiling of 5,420 circulating proteins in 830 adults with type 1 diabetes identified distinct stage-specific pathways—including immune and TNF receptor signaling—associated with disease progression up to a decade before onset.

### Early Trials — Phase I–II

*   **[Biotech] Pharmacological chaperone trial in aspartylglucosaminuria** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43015321/)
    *   An open-label, Phase Ib/II trial evaluated the use of Cystadane as a pharmacological chaperone for aspartylglucosaminuria.
*   **[Biotech] Pipeline updates for ProQR and Absci** [X/Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2120854162309328918)
    *   **[Biotech]** **ProQR** plans to report initial AX-0811 data in early January 2027 and full Phase 1 data for AX-0810 in December 2026.
    *   **[Biotech]** **Absci** expects 13-week interim data for ABS-201 (pattern hair loss) in December 2026, with full 26-week results due in early 2027.

### Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

*   **[Big Pharma] Intismeran autogene Phase 3 results in melanoma** [NEJM](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa2609762)
    *   NEJM published findings on Intismeran autogene combined with pembrolizumab for resected stage IIB to IV melanoma.
*   **[Big Pharma] Iptacopan 24-month IgA nephropathy data** [NEJM](https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMc2611338)
    *   Final 24-month data for **Novartis'** iptacopan in IgA nephropathy was published in the NEJM.
*   **[Biotech] Upcoming data readouts for Soligenix and Pharvaris** [X/Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2120885283298406857)
    *   **[Biotech] Soligenix** expects topline Phase 3 data for SGT-610 in Gorlin syndrome in late November 2026.
    *   **[Biotech] Pharvaris** expects topline Phase 3 data from the CREAATE study (deucrictibant XR) for AAE-C1INH prophylaxis in Q1 2027.
*   **[Big Pharma] Biogen lupus trial results anticipated** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/12/biogen-lupus-litifilimab-what-to-know/)
    *   **[Big Pharma] Biogen** is nearing the release of pivotal clinical trial data for its experimental lupus therapy, litifilimab.

### Regulatory & Approvals

*   **[Big Pharma] First Factor XIa inhibitor approved** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/whats-new-related-drugs)
    *   The FDA approved the first Factor XIa inhibitor for stroke prevention in high-risk adults.
*   **FDA shelves fast-track review initiative** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/12/fda-fast-track-review-shelved-canadian-importer-arrested/)
    *   The agency has discontinued the fast-track drug review initiative introduced in June 2025.
*   **[Biotech] Kyverna Therapeutics files BLA for Miv-Cel** [X/Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2120866114716811732)
    *   **[Biotech] Kyverna** has completed its BLA submission for Miv-Cel in systemic sclerosis and requested priority review.

### Business & Strategy

*   **[Big Pharma] NVIDIA executive leadership transition** [X/Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2120876627584520534)
    *   Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of **[Big Pharma] NVIDIA**; Colette Kress has been named interim CEO.
*   **[Big Pharma] Alnylam faces pressure on heart drug growth** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/alnylam-amvuttra-heart-drug-growth/)
    *   **[Big Pharma] Alnylam** is struggling with slowing sales for its key growth driver, Amvuttra.
*   **[Biotech] Financing updates** [X/Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2120735979082489953)
    *   **[Biotech] PepGen** priced a $125M offering at $5/share.
*   **[Big Pharma] Oral GLP-1 competition in China** [X/Twitter](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2120873080486826190)
    *   **[Big Pharma] Lilly** has reportedly outpaced **[Big Pharma] Novo Nordisk** in bringing an oral GLP-1 obesity treatment to the Chinese market.

### Public Health & Policy

*   **ACS updates prostate cancer screening guidelines** [STAT News](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/12/health-news-experts-update-prostate-cancer-screening-guidelines-for-men/)
    *   The American Cancer Society reversed previous guidance and now recommends routine PSA screening for men aged 50 to 69.
*   **FDA staffing crisis impacts industry** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/fda-staffing-shortages-drug-reviews-pharma/874480/)
    *   Ongoing staffing shortages at the FDA continue to affect the efficiency of drug reviews.
*   **Policy shift on international drug pricing** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/germany-us-drug-price-study-healthcare-costs/874360/)
    *   "Most-favored nations" policy concerns are driving pharmaceutical companies to reconsider international investment and launch strategies, particularly in Germany.

**Worth watching:** FDA Commissioner nominee Heidi Overton remains unconfirmed, with key Senate GOP committee members still undecided on her candidacy.

- Biology & Health
    - [MACF1: A Protein causing Bone Loss (and how to prevent it)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWccVIZrweg) -- Physionic
        - Microtubule-actin crosslinking factor 1 (MACF1) condensates act as molecular rheostats that translate mechanical stress into bone adaptation.
        - Mesenchymal MACF1 promotes bone formation by facilitating the nuclear translocation of SMAD7.
        - High-intensity resistance and impact training leverages mechanical stress to improve bone mineral density and physical function in postmenopausal women with osteopenia and osteoporosis.
    - [Big Tech Keeps Failing in Healthcare](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/a47BWNr-kpI) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Big tech companies face unique structural barriers that cause them to struggle within the healthcare industry.
        - Exceptionally slow sales cycles in healthcare impede the rapid scaling and deployment of big tech products.
        - Securing active technology adoption among clinicians remains a primary obstacle for digital health platforms.
    - [The One Healthcare Job Robots Can’t Replace](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/Fs0Hf24HCZU) -- Health2Tech
        - Human clinicians remain essential in healthcare, particularly in pediatric and emergency settings where critical decisions are required.
        - Autonomous robotics and AI systems cannot fully replace human clinical judgment in high-stakes, life-or-death medical situations.
        - Critical pediatric care decisions mandate human oversight rather than reliance on automated medical systems.
- Other

        - Crash Course's editorial and production teams formulated strategies to cover taboo and divisive subjects including Sex Education, Religion, and U.S. Government.
        - The channel successfully delivers educational content on sensitive topics while effectively navigating engagement-driven, divisive platform algorithms.
        - The process was detailed in a livestream event held during Complexly's annual Learn-a-Thon to promote open access to sensitive knowledge topics.
